name: palambur
description: Palambur Method · asks the decisive questions before producing a business document (job advert, quote, payment reminder, contract, internal memo), then returns the completed Palambur Template and the final deliverable. Swiss safeguards (Gender Equality Act, Data Protection Act, Code of Obligations, Labour Act), data protection by default, no invented data. Built for businesses in French-speaking Switzerland · the skill itself is written in French.
